target_name: Claim Cheapness With Cash After Commitments
rationale: The archive already contains gross cash (che/cogs, +6.3%), cash net of all current liabilities ((che−lct)/cogs, +5.0%) and cash against total debt (che/(dltt+dlc), +4.9%) on the identical valuation leg, so netting out dlc+dvc is a third interpolation point on the same continuum rather than a new mechanism, and the dvc term adds little since dividends are small relative to cogs for most firms.

Merging the highest-slope leg (gross-profit yield) with the highest-alpha leg under the same runway gate is a substantively motivated attempt to resolve a documented FMB/alpha divergence, though the nested SUMRANK weights the claim channel roughly half and the two earnings channels a quarter each — not the "three equally weighted ranks" the reasoning claims — and gross profit and cash earnings are highly collinear, so the incremental information may be smaller than advertised.

Converting the runway gate from a pure stock to stock-plus-flow is an economically sensible fix for the "buffer being drained vs replenished" blind spot, but MA(ib+dp,3) already drives the valuation leg, so the gate partly re-weights the same profitability variable and the expression risks becoming a quadratic in cash earnings rather than an independent conditioning state.

This is a mechanical linear combination of two already-evaluated archive signals rather than a new hypothesis, and the subtraction is not economically clean — the short component carried an insignificant FMB slope (t=−0.54) and both terms are non-negative rank products whose difference is dominated by whichever leg has the wider dispersion, so any gain would reflect portfolio blending, not a tested mechanism.

Holding the denominator and units of the winning gate fixed while swapping the cash stock for the cash flow is a genuine discrimination test that can falsify the "unforced transaction" story against a plain profitability-scaling story, and either outcome is informative; the main caveat is the shared MA(ib+dp,3) term with the valuation leg.

Isolating the combination operator (complements vs substitutes) on the archive's best ingredients is a legitimate structural question the archive has not addressed, but it sits close to a cosmetic re-parameterisation of the champion, and the nested SUMRANK again yields unequal channel weights that undercut the stated "three equally weighted channels" design.
